text: わたしは…　とり　つかれて　おったか

structure.jp: とり　つかれて　おったか

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.span: とり　つかれて　おった
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says a state was going on; おる is the old-man form of いる, so ておった is ていた. とりつかれて おった = 'had been possessed'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: とりつかれる is とりつく 'to possess' turned around, so it is done to the speaker. とりつかれて = 'being possessed'.

patterns.name: 〜か (realizing)
patterns.explanation: か said to yourself is not a real question: it shows you have just noticed something. おったか = 'so I was, huh'.
